actual_cell.topology_justification: Invertible exact affine image of the product of a closed circular annulus (or disk) and a closed axial interval. Positive widths yield an embedded oriented manifold boundary; degenerate widths remain explicit lower-dimensional sets. Orientation follows the coordinate determinant.
actual_cell.representation_containment_justification: Full-period circle/axis support in exact local coordinates. Exact inverse interval maps contain every world translation. Forward and reverse triangle inequalities bound the radial distance. No unit-vector, orthogonality, finite angular sampling, or floating 2*pi endpoint premise is used.
